title: 2013 Honda Pilot Fender Replacement & Door Molding Repair
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair replaced the driver-side fender and repaired door moldings on a maroon 2013 Honda Pilot.
story: Carcis Autobody Repair performed collision repair on a maroon 2013 Honda Pilot with damage along the driver side. The driver-side front fender required full replacement, while the exterior door moldings along the side needed repair.

The damaged front fender panel was removed to prepare the area for a replacement fender. Technicians sanded and smoothed out scrapes on all four door moldings, applying primer to restore surface uniformness prior to refinishing.

The new fender panel and prepped door moldings were painted and clear-coated to match the vehicle's original factory maroon color. After painting, the newly finished components were reinstalled and aligned.
